reviewMode: fresh targeted independent scientific review; never author or synthesis

compoundFreezeBinding.role: Exact final author freeze plus effective source correction

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Alltagsfragen und prüfbare Hypothesen formulieren
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann zu einem beobachtbaren Alltags- oder Technikphänomen eine chemisch untersuchbare Frage und eine durch Beobachtungen prüfbare Hypothese selbst formulieren, die Hypothese begründen und angeben, welcher erwartbare Befund dafür oder dagegen spräche.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Formulate everyday chemical questions and testable hypotheses
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can independently formulate a chemically investigable question and an observation-testable hypothesis about an observable everyday or technological phenomenon, justify the hypothesis and specify an expected finding that would support or contradict it.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: Formulated investigable question plus the learner’s own testable hypothesis, its justification and an expected discriminating observation.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: Both actual DE and EN expressly require independent formulation of question AND hypothesis; providing or selecting a hypothesis is insufficient. The expected support/counterfinding is part of making this one inquiry start testable.
decisions.atomicityReason: One assessable hypothesis-formulation process, whose question and justification set the same testable relation; no unrelated bundle.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: No universal technical/content predecessor is required for a scaffolded everyday phenomenon.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: Repeating a supplied hypothesis; a question without a hypothesis; later interpreting a supplied dataset.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Fragestellungen und Hypothesen theoriegestützt formulieren
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus einer Alltags- oder Techniksituation selbst eine chemisch untersuchbare Fragestellung identifizieren und formulieren, unter Verwendung geeigneter Konzepte oder Theorien eine prüfbare Hypothese selbst formulieren und begründen, daraus einen erwartbaren Befund ableiten und erklären, wie ein geeigneter Gegenbefund der Hypothese widersprechen würde.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Formulate chemical questions and hypotheses using theory
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can independently identify and formulate a chemically investigable question from an everyday or technological situation, formulate and justify a testable hypothesis using appropriate concepts or theories, derive an expected finding and explain how a suitable counter-finding would contradict the hypothesis.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: Own theory-grounded question/hypothesis with a derived prediction and a meaningful counterfinding.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: Theory use remains mandatory in DE and EN, alongside own identification/formulation. BY11:37 and BY12:73–75 support the upper demand; a difficult but theory-free everyday guess is insufficient.
decisions.atomicityReason: Concept/theory, hypothesis and prediction jointly constitute one theoretical inquiry formulation.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: The lower question/hypothesis predecessor is the staged didactic foundation. It must remain a prerequisite-only projection where the upper scope does not target the lower goal; no mastery implication backwards.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: A correct provided hypothesis; merely naming a theory; unsupported assertion of falsification.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Angeleitete chemische Untersuchungen sicher durchführen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann eine angeleitete chemische Untersuchung zu einem Alltags- oder Technikphänomen sicher durchführen, vorgegebene Einflussgrößen und Arbeitsschritte beachten, Beobachtungen oder Messwerte nachvollziehbar protokollieren und erläutern, wie der Versuch die Ausgangshypothese prüft.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Carry out guided chemical investigations safely
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can safely carry out a guided chemical investigation of an everyday or technical phenomenon, follow the specified variables and procedural steps, record observations or measurements transparently, and explain how the experiment tests the initial hypothesis.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: An actually executed safe guided investigation and transparent record related to its initial hypothesis.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: Actual execution is explicitly required in both languages. Question/hypothesis may be supplied. Removing own formulation and the redundant laboratory cluster/method edges preserves the guided-source demand.
decisions.atomicityReason: Execution, specified variables, logging and the immediate hypothesis link belong to one practical investigation.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: Only the actual safety atom13d4… is referenced. Current safety requires laboratory methods416d… transitively; repeating that edge or a broad cluster is redundant.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: Explaining an already performed experiment; fabricated execution; unsafe execution.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Untersuchungen selbst planen und durchführen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann einfache qualitative und quantitative Untersuchungen zur Prüfung chemischer Hypothesen selbst planen, geeignete Einflussgrößen und Vergleichsbedingungen wählen, geeignete Arbeitstechniken sicher anwenden und die tatsächlich ausgeführten Untersuchungen nachvollziehbar protokollieren.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Plan and carry out chemical investigations independently
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can independently plan simple qualitative and quantitative investigations to test chemical hypotheses, select appropriate variables and comparison conditions, use suitable working techniques safely and record the investigations actually performed.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: Actual simple qualitative AND quantitative hypothesis investigations with independent planning, controlled comparisons and records.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: The former OR is replaced by AND in both languages. Original NI printed54 requires simple quantitative planning/execution/protocol, and printed60 qualitative AND quantitative execution/protocol. BY9-NTG:35/40 and BY10:30/35 retain growing autonomy.
decisions.atomicityReason: The one practical hypothesis-testing procedure is applied in two mandatory methodological contexts. It is not a bundle of unrelated content routines; one qualitative success does not clear the quantitative contribution.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: Guided execution/safety and elementary question/hypothesis competence are reasonable progression for the independent investigation branch. Final source-specific guided/independent paths are still separately bindable; supplied hypotheses do not count as independent formulation.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: Only a qualitative investigation; a complex guided experiment counted as independent planning; planning without execution.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Anspruchsvolle chemische Experimente selbstständig durchführen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann hypothesengeleitete qualitative und quantitative Experimente überwiegend selbstständig planen, geeignete Analysenmethoden wählen, unter den Sicherheitsbestimmungen tatsächlich durchführen und nachvollziehbar protokollieren.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Carry out advanced chemical experiments independently
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can largely independently plan hypothesis-guided qualitative and quantitative experiments, select suitable analytical methods, actually perform them under the safety requirements and document them transparently.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: A largely independent actually performed upper-level qualitative/quantitative experiment with appropriate analytical method and protocol.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: The model/simulation clause has been removed from this practical product. BY11:32/37 requires real analytical work; BY12:76–78 permits an explicitly separate model-based route. DE/EN preserve actual execution and autonomy.
decisions.atomicityReason: Planning, analytical choice, safe performance and protocol are one experimental process. Model-only testing is an independently assessable product and now remains in the model prototype.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: Upper theoretical inquiry and lower independent practical competence form the experiment branch. The alternative model branch must not acquire this experimental predecessor or a universal experimental AND completion demand.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: A simulated experiment counted as actual execution; a ready dataset; mere lab-plan narrative.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Daten nachvollziehbar dokumentieren
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann experimentell erhobene oder recherchierte chemische Daten strukturiert und nachvollziehbar dokumentieren, Größen und Einheiten, Herkunft und relevante Untersuchungsbedingungen angeben sowie beobachtende Beschreibung und deutende Erklärung unterscheiden.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Document chemical data transparently
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can document experimental or researched chemical data in a structured and transparent way, identify quantities, units, provenance, and relevant investigation conditions, and distinguish descriptive observation from explanatory interpretation.
decisions.continuityObservation: A traceable data/protocol product remains distinct from a quantitative conclusion.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Daten auswerten und auf Hypothesen beziehen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann erhobene oder recherchierte chemische Daten in geeigneten Tabellen oder Diagrammen auswerten, erkennbare Trends und Beziehungen erläutern und begründen, inwiefern die Daten die Ausgangshypothese stützen oder ihr widersprechen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Evaluate chemical data and relate them to hypotheses
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can evaluate experimental or researched chemical data in suitable tables or diagrams, explain observable trends and relationships, and justify how the data support or contradict the initial hypothesis.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: Hypothesis-related justified interpretation of tabulated/graphed chemical data.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: Descriptions remain exact; the changed prerequisite/scope now correctly permits a supplied initial hypothesis. BY8:38 and BY9-NTG:43 require data-to-hypothesis interpretation, not new hypothesis authorship.
decisions.atomicityReason: Data organization, relationship reading and the evidential claim form one interpretation product.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: Data-documentation alone supplies the essential legibility/provenance foundation. Removing the own-formulation edge removes an unnecessary universal gate.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: Graph reading without relating data to the initial hypothesis; hypothesis formulation without evaluating data.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Daten quantitativ und hypothesenbezogen auswerten
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann für eine chemische Fragestellung geeignete mathematische Auswertungsverfahren und digitale Werkzeuge auswählen und begründet anwenden, quantitative Zusammenhänge unter Beachtung der Untersuchungsbedingungen interpretieren und daraus fachübergreifend begründete Schlüsse zur Stützung oder Falsifizierung der Ausgangshypothese ziehen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Evaluate chemical data quantitatively in relation to hypotheses
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can select and apply suitable mathematical analysis methods and digital tools with justification for a chemical question, interpret quantitative relationships while accounting for the investigation conditions, and derive justified interdisciplinary conclusions that support or falsify the initial hypothesis.
decisions.continuityObservation: Mathematical/digital quantitative interpretation and its hypothesis conclusion remain one evaluation process; upper demand unchanged.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Die Aussagekraft chemischer Daten beurteilen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Angemessenheit, Gültigkeit und Tragweite erhobener oder recherchierter chemischer Daten beurteilen, mögliche Mess- und Verfahrensfehler anhand der Untersuchungsbedingungen begründen und erklären, welche Schlussfolgerungen die Daten tragen und welche nicht.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Assess the evidential value of chemical data
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can assess the suitability, validity, and reach of experimental or researched chemical data, justify possible measurement and procedural errors using the investigation conditions, and explain which conclusions the data support and which they do not.
decisions.continuityObservation: The suitability/validity/reach judgment remains distinct from performing calculations and from the formal scientific validity criterion list.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Erkenntniswege und ihre Reichweite erklären
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an einem vorgegebenen chemischen Erkenntnisweg erklären, wie Fragestellung, Methoden, Beobachtungen und Interpretation zusammenwirken, welche Fragen damit chemisch beantwortbar sind und welche Unsicherheiten oder Grenzen bestehen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Explain chemical inquiry processes and their reach
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can explain how questions, methods, observations, and interpretation work together in a given chemical inquiry process, which questions can be answered chemically through it, and which uncertainties or limitations remain.
decisions.continuityObservation: Explanation of a provided inquiry retains the foreign-case boundary; no own execution is inferred.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Eigene chemische Untersuchungen reflektieren
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Ergebnisse einer eigenen chemischen Untersuchung auf ihre Ausgangsfrage und Hypothese beziehen, die eigenen Methoden- und Vorgehensentscheidungen begründen, erkennbare Unsicherheiten oder Grenzen erläutern und konkrete Verbesserungen für eine weitere Untersuchung ableiten.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Reflect on chemical investigations of one's own
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can relate the results of a chemical investigation of their own to its initial question and hypothesis, justify their own methodological and procedural decisions, explain observable uncertainties or limitations, and derive concrete improvements for a further investigation.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: A reasoned reflection on an investigation actually carried out by the learner, identifying improvements.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: Actual own performance is mandatory; own planning is not. BY12:93–95 speaks of own process/results. The retained wording can refer to the learner’s actual execution/adaptation decisions in a guided experiment; it does not silently require independent design.
decisions.atomicityReason: Question/result relation, reasoning about method and limitations, and actionable improvement constitute one reflective inquiry account.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: Guided execution plus lower data interpretation is sufficient. An independently planned experiment is an admissible stronger case, not a universal gate. A purely foreign case remains insufficient.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: Historical/foreign inquiry presented as own; generic error list unrelated to own performance; an unperformed experiment.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Wissenschaftliche Gültigkeitskriterien anwenden
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Gültigkeit chemischer Erkenntnisse und die Möglichkeiten und Grenzen des Erkenntnisgewinnungsprozesses anhand von Reproduzierbarkeit, Falsifizierbarkeit, Intersubjektivität, logischer Konsistenz und Vorläufigkeit begründet reflektieren. Dabei unterscheidet sie belastbare Gegenbefunde von fehlgeschlagener Durchführung oder unzuverlässiger Messung.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Apply criteria of scientific validity
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can reflect with justification on the validity of chemical findings and the possibilities and limits of inquiry using reproducibility, falsifiability, intersubjectivity, logical consistency, and provisionality. They distinguish robust counterevidence from failed procedures or unreliable measurements.
decisions.continuityObservation: The named five scientific criteria and reliable counterevidence condition remain exact; no automatic falsification is introduced.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Informationen aus Quellen erschließen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann zur Beantwortung einer chemischen Frage relevante Informationen aus vorgegebenen oder selbst recherchierten Texten, Bildern und anderen Darstellungen auswählen, fachlich strukturieren, adressaten- und situationsgerecht auswerten und die verwendeten Quellen angeben.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Extract chemical information from sources
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can select relevant information from given or independently researched texts, images, and other representations to answer a chemical question, structure it scientifically, evaluate it for the audience and situation, and identify the sources used.
decisions.continuityObservation: The bounded source-based chemical response remains distinct from experiment and presentation.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Komplexe chemische Quellen selbstständig erschließen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann zu chemischen oder pharmazeutischen Fragen selbstständig in analogen und digitalen Medien recherchieren, relevante Informationen und Daten auch aus komplexen Darstellungen auswählen, strukturieren und interpretieren, daraus fachliche Schlussfolgerungen ableiten sowie Quellen belegen und Zitate kennzeichnen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Independently interpret complex chemistry sources
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can independently research chemical or pharmaceutical questions in analogue and digital media, select, structure, and interpret relevant information and data from complex representations, derive scientific conclusions, cite sources, and mark quotations.
decisions.continuityObservation: Actual complex independent research/interpretation and citation remain exact and separate from source criticism and presentation.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Quellen und Darstellungen kritisch prüfen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann analoge und digitale Quellen oder Darstellungsformen zu chemischen Sachverhalten hinsichtlich ihrer Aussagen, fachlichen Relevanz, Vertrauenswürdigkeit, Urheberschaft und Intention vergleichen und ihre Eignung und Validität für eine konkrete Frage begründet beurteilen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Critically assess chemistry sources and representations
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can compare analogue and digital sources or representations of chemical issues in terms of their claims, scientific relevance, trustworthiness, authorship, and intention, and justify their suitability and validity for a specific question.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: A comparative, justified suitability/validity judgment on chemical sources or representations.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: Complex sources may be supplied. Own complex research is a distinct product; the new lower-source predecessor preserves accessibility without deleting source authorship/intention/validity criteria. BY12 B2/B4 still requires actual self-acquired sources in its particular source binding; that condition may be evidenced through the separate source-information goal/case and is not globally waived.
decisions.atomicityReason: Multiple reliability/relevance/intent criteria inspect the same source suitability judgment; one coherent appraisal, not independent research plus presentation.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: Basic source extraction is an appropriate essential foundation; complex independent searching is not universal. B2/B4 self-research remains a local final-case/source requirement.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: An author-name check alone; source retrieval alone; declaring every NI source mapping exact.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Pro- und Kontra-Argumente abwägen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann zu einem chemischen Sachverhalt relevante Bewertungskriterien recherchieren oder erkennen, fachlich belegte Pro- und Kontra-Argumente selbst finden, sie mit bereitgestellten Argumenten vergleichen und deren Gewicht kriteriengeleitet begründet abwägen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Weigh arguments for and against chemical claims
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can research or identify relevant assessment criteria for a chemical issue, independently find scientifically supported arguments for and against, compare them with supplied arguments and weigh them with justified reference to the criteria.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: Independently found evidenced pro/contra arguments, compared and weighed against relevant criteria.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: DE and EN now require own finding. BY9-NTG:69 demands finding AND comparing. BY8:74 given-argument comparison remains a partial guided contribution; it cannot fully close the extended independent product.
decisions.atomicityReason: Finding, evidential comparison and weight determine one argument appraisal. Action options and a complete decision strategy remain a different product.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: Basic source extraction makes the scientific evidence available. Independent upper research is not a universal requirement.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: Only a supplied pro/contra list; an opinion duel without chemical evidence; merely naming criteria.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Anwendungen und ihre gesellschaftliche Bedeutung diskutieren
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Aufgaben und Anwendungsbereiche der Chemie an konkreten Beispielen beschreiben und ihre Bedeutung für Gesellschaft, Mensch und Umwelt fachlich begründet diskutieren.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Discuss chemical applications and their social significance
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can describe tasks and application areas of chemistry using concrete examples and discuss their significance for society, people, and the environment with scientific justification.
decisions.continuityObservation: Concrete application/social discussion remains a partial original-family contribution, distinct from career choice.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Berufsfelder in eine begründete Berufswahl einbeziehen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann vielfältige chemische Berufsfelder anhand ihrer Aufgaben, Anwendungsbereiche und Anforderungen vergleichen, ihren Zusammenhang mit chemischen Anwendungen und gesellschaftlichen Entwicklungen erläutern und diese Informationen in eine begründete Berufsorientierung oder Berufswahl einbeziehen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Include chemistry career fields in informed career decisions
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can compare diverse chemical occupations in terms of their tasks, fields of application, and requirements, explain their connection with chemical applications and social developments, and use this information for justified career orientation or a career choice.
decisions.continuityObservation: Evidence-based career orientation/use remains exact; no human career decision or motivational-orientation completion is asserted.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Handlungsoptionen kriteriengeleitet bewerten
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann bei einer chemisch relevanten Alltags- oder Gesellschaftsentscheidung ethische, ökologische, ökonomische, soziale und sicherheitsbezogene Kriterien ableiten, Chancen und Risiken beurteilen, begründete Handlungsoptionen formulieren und mit einer passenden Entscheidungsstrategie abwägen. Sie überprüft Entscheidung, Kriterien und Strategie und reflektiert Möglichkeiten und Grenzen chemischer Sichtweisen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Evaluate chemical action options using criteria
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can derive ethical, environmental, economic, social, and safety-related criteria for a chemistry-related everyday or societal decision, assess opportunities and risks, formulate justified options, and weigh them using a suitable decision strategy. They review the decision, criteria, and strategy and reflect on the possibilities and limits of chemical perspectives.
decisions.continuityObservation: Criteria/options/strategy and reflective decision retain the same integrated product, distinct from argument comparison alone.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Einflüsse auf die Entwicklung chemischen Wissens bewerten
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an chemischen Beispielen soziale, kulturelle, technologische, historische, ökologische und ökonomische Einflüsse auf die Entwicklung naturwissenschaftlichen Wissens beschreiben und begründet bewerten, ohne empirische Gültigkeit mit gesellschaftlicher Zustimmung gleichzusetzen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Assess influences on the development of chemical knowledge
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can describe and assess social, cultural, technological, historical, environmental, and economic influences on the development of scientific knowledge using chemistry examples, without equating empirical validity with social approval.
decisions.continuityObservation: Social/cultural/technological/historical/environmental/economic influence on knowledge development remains exact and distinct from product effects.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Wirkungen in historischen und aktuellen Zusammenhängen bewerten
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann gesellschaftliche und ökologische Bedeutung sowie Auswirkungen chemischer Produkte, Methoden, Verfahren und Erkenntnisse in historischen und aktuellen Zusammenhängen beschreiben und aus ökologischer, ökonomischer und sozialer Nachhaltigkeitsperspektive begründet bewerten. Dabei reflektiert sie auch mögliche Auswirkungen des eigenen Handelns.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Assess chemical impacts in historical and current contexts
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can describe the social and environmental significance and impacts of chemical products, methods, processes, and findings in historical and current contexts and assess them with justification from environmental, economic, and social sustainability perspectives. They also reflect on possible impacts of their own actions.
decisions.continuityObservation: Historical/current chemical effects and three sustainability perspectives plus own action reflection retain exact scope.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Sachverhalte fachlich diskutieren
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann chemische Sachverhalte fachlich schlüssig erklären, begründet argumentieren, sich konstruktiv austauschen und den eigenen Standpunkt anhand fachlicher Argumente reflektieren oder korrigieren.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Discuss chemical issues scientifically
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can explain chemical issues coherently, argue with justification, exchange ideas constructively, and reflect on or correct their own standpoint using scientific arguments.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: A real coherent constructive chemical discussion with reasoned argument and responsive standpoint reflection/correction.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: Descriptions remain exact in both languages. BY12:135–137 plus146–148 support the full product. Actual23 NI rows are upper-level and three marked eA/LK; isolated reflection, comparison or reasoning is only partial evidence of full dialogue.
decisions.atomicityReason: Explanation and argument, exchange and responsive standpoint review are phases of one scientific discourse. No universal pro/contra normative decision or independent search is bundled.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: The existing technical-language atom95dc… is an appropriate foundation. Current transitive content chain was inspected read-only. Case facts may be supplied. Its existing text/evidence cannot be changed mechanically by this review.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: A monologue; a correct calculation; an isolated reflection row cleared as the whole dialog; demanding complex independent research in every discussion.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Modelle nutzen, vergleichen und weiterentwickeln
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann für eine chemische Fragestellung oder prüfbare Hypothese geeignete analoge oder digitale Modelle und Simulationen zu Materie, chemischen Reaktionen, Bindungen und Wechselwirkungen auswählen und nutzen, ihre Aussagen mit Beobachtungen und miteinander vergleichen, Grenzen benennen und begründen, weshalb ein Modell hinterfragt oder weiterentwickelt werden muss.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Use, compare, and improve chemistry models
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can select and use suitable analogue or digital models and simulations of matter, chemical reactions, bonding and interactions for a chemical question or testable hypothesis, compare their predictions with observations and with each other, identify limitations and justify why a model should be questioned or developed further.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: Purposeful selection/use and evidence-related comparison/critique of a lower chemical model.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: The added chemical question/testable hypothesis restores BY10:51. DE and EN retain appropriate model/simulation selection and evidence comparison; EN predictions is read as model-derived claims in this hypothesis-use context, including structural implications rather than requiring future temporal prediction. BY8:48/51 and BY9-NTG:49 support critique and development need.
decisions.atomicityReason: Selection, use, comparison and criticism form one model-evaluation routine. Matter, reaction, bonding and interaction cases are contexts of that same routine; the actual content model remains independently taught.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: An empty universal requires list is appropriate: Dalton knowledge is not necessary for every interaction/reaction model. Supply the relevant model facts or bind a genuinely relevant local content prerequisite.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: Naming a model without using it for the question; a generic limit list; requiring Dalton for every model type.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Modelle theoriegestützt nutzen und kritisch vergleichen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann für chemische Fragestellungen geeignete analoge und digitale Modelle oder Simulationen zu Atombau und Periodizität, chemischen Gleichgewichten, Bindungsverhältnissen und Molekülgeometrien sowie Wechselwirkungen komplexer Moleküle einschließlich Wirkstoff–Rezeptor- und Substrat–Enzym-Beziehungen auswählen und nutzen, Aussagen oder Hypothesen damit prüfen und ihre Aussagekraft, Grenzen und möglichen Weiterentwicklungen anhand von Beobachtungen oder Vergleichen begründen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Use and critically compare chemical models with theory
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: For chemical questions, the learner can select and use appropriate analogue and digital models or simulations of atomic structure and periodicity, chemical equilibria, bonding and molecular geometry, and interactions of complex molecules including drug–receptor and substrate–enzyme relationships, test statements or hypotheses and justify their explanatory power, limitations and possible development from observations or comparisons.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: Theory-supported chemical model/simulation selection, hypothesis test and justified critical evaluation across the mandatory upper contexts.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: C11.1.6 is the actual source at52–54, whereas47 is the spreadsheet clause. The final DE/EN includes bonding, geometry, drug–receptor and substrate–enzyme relationships, and retains atomic structure/periodicity and equilibria from upper theory/model clauses. Both analogue and digital forms remain explicit.
decisions.atomicityReason: The same model-selection/use/evaluation process has several mandatory contexts; these are not independent unrelated operator routines. Context union does not permit one simple water/atomic/equilibrium case to clear every required context. Content-specific enzyme/hybridization/equilibrium goals remain distinct.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: The lower model routine is the sole universal predecessor; own lab performance and every specialized content model are not universal hard edges. Appropriate subject knowledge must be supplied or actually linked in each final case.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: Only a simple molecule comparison; only equilibrium; omitted binding/geometry/complex-interaction cases; model testing counted as actual lab execution.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Informationen in geeignete Darstellungen überführen
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann chemische Informationen sach-, adressaten- und situationsgerecht in eine geeignete Darstellungsform überführen, dabei Fachsprache und Bezugsgrößen korrekt verwenden und die Darstellungswahl sowie erhaltene und begrenzte Aussagen begründen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Transform chemical information into suitable representations
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can transform chemical information into a representation suited to its content, audience and situation, use scientific language and reference quantities correctly and justify the choice and the statements retained or limited by that representation.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: An actually transformed chemical informational representation, adapted to content/audience/situation, with justified form and preserved/limited meaning.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: BY12:125–127 requires an actual representational transformation and reflective choice; BY11:68/118 reinforces this. DE/EN preserve actual transformation, scientific language/reference quantities and justified retained/limited claims. Reading a source is a different product. Existing Fachsprache/Alltagssprache atom complements the K5/6/7/9 source union; this prototype does not alone approve that union.
decisions.atomicityReason: Form choice, transformation and reflection on what the form preserves/limits are one representation product. Text/data/process transformations cannot all be replaced by the separate molecular-formula goal.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: Basic source information competence is the only proposed universal predecessor; input data/content can be given. No universal complex research, Dalton, or molecular-formula gate is needed.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: Only reading complex material; only quoting a source; only transforming a molecule formula to claim all informational representations.

decisions.actualTitleDe: Chemische Sachverhalte und Arbeitsergebnisse präsentieren
decisions.actualDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann chemische Sachverhalte sowie eigene Lern- oder Arbeitsergebnisse mit geeigneten analogen und digitalen Medien sach-, adressaten- und situationsgerecht präsentieren und die Wahl von Darstellung, Aufbau und Medium begründen.
decisions.actualTitleEn: Present chemical subject matter and work results
decisions.actualDescriptionEn: The learner can present chemical subject matter and their own learning or work results using suitable analogue and digital media in a way appropriate to the content, audience and situation, and justify the representation, structure and medium.
decisions.actualSuccessProduct: An actual content/audience/situation-appropriate presentation of chemical subject matter AND the learner’s learning/work results using appropriate analogue AND digital media.
decisions.operatorAndSourceFinding: The effective source is BY12 lines138–140, applied by the exact frozen correction. Actual DE/EN retains both subject matter and own learning/work-result products plus both media forms; results may be one learning/work artifact, not two artificial quotas. Merely understanding a text or choosing a medium is insufficient.
decisions.atomicityReason: Selecting structure/form/media and presenting one chemical result/account are one presentation process. It is assessably different from preparation/transformation alone or critical discourse.
decisions.minimalPrerequisiteReason: Representation transformation is appropriate preparation. Own learning/work material is required, but own complex research or independent laboratory planning is not a universal predecessor.
decisions.falseSuccessesExcluded: A reading summary never presented; selecting a slide template; only molecule-formula conversion; a foreign result mislabeled as own learning/work.

atomicityRule: One coherent process with several primary-source mandatory contexts can be atomic. Context union still needs honest separate coverage; it cannot be closed by a generic instance. Independent performance products are kept distinct.
